app.title: Spike 2 — Parser library & Unified AST
app.intro: Serve over HTTP from the repo root (python3 -m http.server) and open /apps/parser-lab/. Run node scripts/bundle.mjs first to create dist/dawviz-parser.bundle.js.
lang.label: Language
file.label: Project file (.als .alp .rpp .dawproject .mid, or binary with a schema):
pack.title: This .alp pack contains several .als files — pick one:
pack.loaded: Read {container} pack in {ms} ms: {count, plural, one {# .als file} other {# .als files}}. Pick the file to view; the analysis runs automatically.
midi.title: This Reaper project references external .mid file(s) — load them too (multiple files allowed):
schema.title: This binary format is not supported directly yet — you can load a JSON schema that describes its structure:
notice.missingMidi: External .mid not loaded ({files}): the project will have no notes (or incomplete notes) until you load them.
notice.missingSchema: The .{ext} format is not supported yet. Bitwig: export a .dawproject; FL Studio: export a .mid; or load a JSON schema that describes the file.
notice.tempoUnknown: Tempo could not be read from the file (source: {source}); using {bpm} BPM. If that is wrong, enter the BPM in the “Override BPM” box below.
tempo.legend: Override BPM (optional; empty = use the tempo in the file)
tempo.unit.label: Position format:
tempo.unit.time: Time: seconds or m:ss.mmm (every DAW has a time clock, e.g. Reaper 0:00.000)
tempo.hint: The first point counts from 0; later points are converted in order using the previous BPM. Bar.Beat input counts bars using each row's time signature (the file's is {sig}). A time-signature change is assumed to start on a bar line.
out.source: Source: {format} {version} | source PPQ {ppq} | {ticks} ticks = {seconds} s | tempo points: {points}
warnings.title: Warnings:
selftest.result: PPQ 960 vs 480 self-test: {verdict} — {matched}/{total} notes matched, max start offset {delta} ticks
errors.ERR_ARCHIVE_INVALID: The archive or pack is damaged or has an unexpected structure.
errors.ERR_ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE: The archive expands beyond the safety limits (size, ratio or entry count).
errors.ERR_AST_INVALID: The project data is invalid (for example an out-of-range BPM or position).
errors.ERR_AST_TOO_LARGE: The project has too many notes or is nested too deeply to process.
errors.ERR_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the allowed limit.
errors.ERR_NO_NOTES: No notes were found. Try showing muted tracks, choosing another .als in the pack, loading the referenced .mid, or choosing another file.
errors.ERR_NO_SUPPORTED_ENV: This browser lacks a required feature (DecompressionStream). Use a recent Chrome or Edge.
errors.ERR_PARSER_TIMEOUT: Analysis took too long and was stopped.
errors.ERR_SCHEMA_INVALID: The binary schema is invalid or missing its AST mapping.
errors.ERR_WORKER_CRASHED: The analysis worker stopped unexpectedly (often out of memory with very large files). Try again or use a smaller file.
errors.ERR_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This format is not supported yet, or the content does not match the file extension.
errors.ERR_WORKER: The analysis worker could not start. Did you run node scripts/bundle.mjs and open the page over HTTP from the repo root?
warn.WARN_ALP_MULTIPLE_ALS: The pack has several .als files; the largest was chosen by default.
warn.WARN_DAWPROJECT_NO_NOTE_TRACKS: The DAWproject has no note tracks.
warn.WARN_MIDI_HANGING_NOTES: Some notes never received a note-off and were closed at the end.
warn.WARN_MIDI_TRUNCATED: The MIDI file is truncated; the valid part was read.
warn.WARN_RPP_EXTERNAL_MIDI: An item references an external .mid that was not provided.
warn.WARN_RPP_HANGING_NOTES: Some notes in the Reaper MIDI never ended and were closed at the end.
warn.WARN_RPP_LOOPED_ITEMS: Looped MIDI items were repeated to their item length [to be verified].
warn.WARN_RPP_LOOP_UNKNOWN_LEN: A looped item has an unknown source length and was not repeated.
warn.WARN_RPP_PROJOFFS: The project start offset (PROJOFFS) is not applied.
warn.WARN_RPP_SOFFS: A source start offset (SOFFS) was applied as quarter notes [to be verified].
warn.WARN_RPP_SRC_UNIT: A MIDI source uses a timebase other than quarter notes (or an invalid PPQ), which is not supported yet; the item was skipped. Re-save the project in a recent Reaper.
warn.WARN_SESSION_CLIPS_IGNORED: Session View clips are not read (only the Arrangement).
warn.WARN_TEMPO_AUTOMATION: Tempo automation was read from the file.
warn.WARN_TEMPO_AUTOMATION_SECONDS: Tempo automation in seconds is not supported yet.
warn.WARN_TEMPO_FALLBACK: No tempo found; 120 BPM is used. Enter the BPM if it is wrong.
warn.WARN_TEMPO_MIDI_DEFAULT: The MIDI file has no Set Tempo; the standard 120 BPM is used. Enter the BPM if it is wrong.
warn.WARN_TEMPO_OVERRIDDEN: The file's tempo was replaced by your override.
warn.WARN_TEMPO_RAMP: A tempo ramp was approximated with small steps.
warn.WARN_TEMPO_SHAPE: A curved tempo envelope was approximated with straight lines.
warn.WARN_TIMESIG_DEFAULT: No time signature found; 4/4 is used.
warn.WARN_TIME_UNIT_MIXED: The project mixes beat and second time units.
warn.WARN_ZERO_LENGTH_NOTES: Zero-length notes were extended to 1 tick.
warn.WARN_RPP_ENVELOPES_IGNORED: Some automation envelopes are not read yet (inside items/takes, pre-FX, stereo width, or duplicates of a type already read).
auto.volume: Volume: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}, {min} to {max} dB
auto.pan: Pan: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
auto.mute: Mute: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} (raw values)
warn.WARN_RPP_ENVELOPE_SHAPE_APPROX: Curved envelope segments (slow/fast/bezier) are approximated with a smooth curve.

web.drop.hint: Supported: .als .alp .rpp .dawproject .mid. If a Reaper project references external .mid files, select them together with the project.

web.style.title: Note style
web.missing.title: {n, plural, one {This project uses # external MIDI file that hasn't been added} other {This project uses # external MIDI files that haven't been added}}
web.missing.errorHint: No notes can be shown until you add them. In Reaper they are usually next to the project file or in its Media folder.
web.missing.warnHint: The tracks that use them stay empty until you add them. In Reaper they are usually next to the project file or in its Media folder.
web.missing.dropHint: or drop them here. You don't need to choose the project file again. Names match ignoring case, and spaces count the same as underscores.
web.missing.unused: Not used, because the name doesn't match any reference: {files}
web.glow.hint.velocity: Harder-played notes glow more when the playhead reaches them.
web.glow.hint.pitch: Higher notes glow more, measured within the Piano Roll's pitch range.
web.glow.hint.fade: Brightest at the moment of the hit, fading out until the note ends.
web.glow.hint.automation: Glow follows the chosen automation lane while the note plays. Tracks without that lane glow evenly.
web.tracks.columns.limited: {n, plural, one {Only # column fits at this width.} other {Only # columns fit at this width.}}
web.glow.hint.pan.lr: Follows the track's pan when the note starts: hard left = weakest, hard right = strongest.
web.glow.hint.pan.spread: Follows the track's pan when the note starts: centre = weakest, the further left or right the stronger.
